name: cTSEffectCurve::Reset (the kind's defaults)
notes: Lane IW. A wave: resize(4, 0) keeping the values there, then 1 and 2 pi; any other kind: SetConstant(0). Hooked to the member. EffectCurve_Operations: 400 seeds x 30 random operations (Reset, SetConstant, SetKind with list / wave / other kinds, Simplify, SetValues with 0-6 values, often equal, sometimes its own vector, GetMax, Read from scripted tapes with failing float reads, Write) on curves the original and our default constructors built, compared after each (kind, count, capacity, value bits, the streams' and the check stand-in's call logs). Mutants as 0xbdc8f0 (resize vs assign, the 2 pi slot: killed).

notes: Lane IW. List kind, resize to one value unless it has exactly one (the byte count rounded down to whole values), the value. Hooked to the member (noinline: the meta-particle commands' test stands in for it). EffectCurve_Operations as 0xbdcb80; mutant (always resize + shrink) killed.

name: cTSEffectCurve::Simplify (a list of equal values becomes their constant)
notes: Lane IW. Lists only, two values or more, float != (NaN never equal; -0 equals 0). Hooked to the member. EffectCurve_Operations as 0xbdcb80; loop-cap mutants (count <= 2, last value skipped) killed.

name: cTSEffectCurve::SetValues (from parsed values)
notes: Lane IW. The game's check 0xbdcdb0 first (throws the game's exception for a wave's zero amplitude or frequency: not ours, kept as an original call), Reset, then a wave takes min(n, 4) values with the frequency times 2 pi when n >= 2, a list takes them all (assign) unless they are its own or none; then Simplify. Hooked to the member (noinline: the particle commands' tests stand in for it). EffectCurve_Operations as 0xbdcb80 with the check stood in on both sides (logs kind and count); mutants on the cap (3), the 2 pi condition (n >= 1), the empty / own-vector test, the dropped Simplify and the check's order all killed.

name: cTSEffectCurve::GetMax
notes: Lane IW. A wave: |amplitude| + offset (values 0 and 3); a list: the largest value (maxss order: a NaN value is skipped), -FLT_MAX for none; other kinds -FLT_MAX. Hooked to the member. EffectCurve_Operations and EffectCurve_Max (chosen lists: NaN first / last / alone, empty, -0 and 0, -FLT_MAX, each kind); mutants: no fabs, FLT_MIN start killed; the swapped comparison is equivalent (matchcheck shows the same maxss either way).

name: cTSEffectCurve::Read
notes: Lane IW. One word: kind (top byte) and count (low 24 bits), read over a temporary that starts as the stream pointer (the original's argument slot). A wave: resize(4, 0) and min(count, 4) floats; a list with a count: resize(count) and count floats; anything else (a list of none, other kinds): list kind and Reset. Hooked to the member. EffectCurve_Operations (tapes: list counts 0-7, wave 0-6, other kinds, failing and missing float reads) and EffectCurve_ReadFailedWord (a stream at 0x81000003 whose word read fails: a wave of three values on both sides). Mutants: the wave cap (5), assign vs resize, count + 1, the temporary's start (0) killed; the dropped other-kind reset to the list kind is equivalent (Reset sets it).

name: cTSEffectCurve::Write
notes: Lane IW. The kind OR the count, then the values as floats (stream slots 9 and 12). Hooked to the member. EffectCurve_Operations as 0xbdcb80 (the out stream logs each value); the kind-dropped mutant killed.
